title: An agent with its own badge
sub: Film 5 of 7 of From helper to colleague: one identity per agent, so its work can be seen and stopped. All year, Jun's helper drafted Planning's changes on his own sign-in, so every change said Jun. The planning agent has a badge of its own in every tool: a service principal in Databricks, an App in GitHub and the same sign-in in dbt, its rights from its role's group, no secret it can see or leak, a place of its own to work, its name in every log, and a switch that stops it alone.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's marble and oak. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is tools and structure (the badge's tools, the group, its grants, the vault and the locks), violet the model and what an agent does (its band, its own lines in a log), orange data coming back, green a check that passes, and amber something wrong (the changes nobody could place, a secret that could leak, a call refused). The agents look alike: each wears its badge, with its name on it.
